title: The Spanish execute the Inca emperor Atahualpa
summary: Although his subjects had filled a room with gold and silver as his ransom, Atahualpa was tried by the Spanish and executed by garrotte in Cajamarca.
reason: Pizarro feared Atahualpa would lead a rebellion and accused him of plotting and of killing his brother Huascar.
significance: His death left the Inca state leaderless and opened the road to Cusco for the conquerors.
